note: What a server sends to turn a unit toward something. Its identifier is wider than a byte, so it travels behind the escape.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What the unit is turning toward. The values are not yet told apart.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where to look, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where to look, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object being looked at, where one is named.
